name: VoicePrivacy 2020 Challenge
description: The VoicePrivacy Challenge aims to promote the development of privacy preservation tools for speech technology by gathering a new community to define the tasks of interest and the evaluation methodology, and benchmarking solutions through a series of challenges. In this document, we formulate the voice anonymization task selected for the VoicePrivacy 2020 Challenge and describe the datasets used for system development and evaluation. We also present the attack models and the associated objective and subjective evaluation metrics. We introduce two anonymization baselines and report objective evaluation results.
evaluation_method: Objective metrics (EER for privacy, WER for utility) complemented by human_eval (subjective assessments)
general_score_metric: EER (primary for privacy) and WER (primary for utility)
reputation: A well-known community challenge in speech-privacy that defined common tasks and evaluation protocols and has been widely used by researchers in the field.
notes: Evaluation is multi-faceted (privacy vs utility) and depends strongly on attacker models; includes both objective and subjective evaluations; non-LLM/audio benchmark; results not directly comparable to single-number metrics.
